title.zh: 【Marqeta 与 Coinbase 合作推出稳定币支付卡服务】
title.en: 【Marqeta 与 Coinbase 合作推出稳定币支付卡服务】

current_state.zh: Marqeta and Coinbase launched a joint service letting crypto-native and traditional enterprises issue bank cards funded by stablecoin balances, with Coinbase handling custody and fiat conversion and Base providing on-chain settlement.
current_state.en: Marqeta and Coinbase launched a joint service letting crypto-native and traditional enterprises issue bank cards funded by stablecoin balances, with Coinbase handling custody and fiat conversion and Base providing on-chain settlement.
